articles.title: OCC's final rule to start fresh in weighing stablecoin rewards against GENIUS Act ban
articles.snippet: The U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency is the first of several federal agencies to finish writing regulations under the act.

articles.title: A company that vouches for websites had secret keys so weak that 8 of them were cracked
articles.snippet: Eight secret keys at eMudhra, an Indian firm that vouches for websites, were compromised. This is a generic, not crypto-specific, risk.

articles.title: OKX-ICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo calls corporate objections a ‘natural response’ to tokenized stock plans
articles.snippet: The former NY governor, who co-chairs the joint venture between the crypto exchange and Intercontinental Exchange, said companies were expected to take a wait-and-see approach.

articles.title: The Coinbase allegations expose Bitcoin's corporate governance gap
articles.snippet: Corporate adoption of bitcoin will stall as long as companies can't show who controls the money, who approves its movement, or whether it's still there, argues Onramp CEO Michael Tanguma.

articles.title: UK financial watchdog opens consultations for DeFi guidance, crypto laws
articles.snippet: The UK Financial Conduct Authority consultations came just weeks after the agency opened applications for companies under its new crypto regulatory regime.
